annotation.title_clean: Joint Statement in Support of the CCW LAWS GGE
annotation.title_en: Joint Statement in Support of the CCW LAWS GGE
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Australia, Canada, Denmark, Estonia, Germany, Poland, Portugal, Singapore, Sweden, United Kingdom (CCW GGE on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons, Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2025/WP.8)
annotation.summary_en: Joint working paper by ten states supporting the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It praises the Chair's rolling text and urges consensus on characterising LAWS and on 'context appropriate human control and judgement', plus early planning for the text's final form and next steps.
key_provisions_or_claims: Supports the Chair's rolling text as basis for consensus outcome
Calls for settling characterisation issues regarding LAWS
Calls for agreement on 'context appropriate human control and judgement'
Urges early consideration of the rolling text's final structure
Urges High Contracting Parties to contemplate next steps beyond the GGE
